$comment: Root ADR-0280. How 차세대 온비드 (KAMCO Onbid) public-sale data is fetched from data.go.kr, what a response must look like, and the call budget. The collector (`collect-data-go-kr-onbid` in services/foundation-outbox-publisher), the Silver load (infra/lakehouse/spark/jobs/data_go_kr_onbid.py) and their tests read this file; nothing else restates these values. The service key is the platform's DATA_GO_KR_SERVICE_KEY and is never written here or into Bronze (the request fingerprint drops it). Measured 2026-10-19: every list item carries a 19-digit ltnoPnu; about 78,400 real-estate items are open (pvctTrgtYn N about 61,600, Y about 16,800); one full item pass is about 95 calls and 137 MB of JSON, 8.8 MB gzipped.

result_codes.$comment: header.resultCode (or result.resultCode on an error body). 00 is rows; 03 (NODATA_ERROR) is a valid empty answer for a combination with no open items. Any other code refuses the run: a key, quota or parameter problem must not read as 'no items'.

daily_call_limit_per_api.$comment: The data.go.kr development-account limit counts each API (활용신청) separately. The collector stops an API before it would pass its limit for the KST day and records the stop; it never spreads one API's calls over another's quota. Raise these only after the operating-account upgrade is approved.

property_division_codes.$comment: prptDivCd, a mandatory parameter of every list API (the provider's own meanings, swagger 2026-03-20). Every code is asked: a code with no open items costs one call and answers 03.

item_list.$comment: 물건목록 (data.go.kr 15157207). Only open rounds are listed: an item condition (cltrMngNo, pbctCdtnNo) leaves the list when its bidding ends, so a key absent from a complete pass is a closed round and is asked once at item_bid_result. A pass is complete only when every (prptDivCd, pvctTrgtYn) combination was read to its last page; an incomplete pass lands in Bronze but marks nothing removed.

announcement_list.$comment: 공고목록 (data.go.kr 15157216). cltrTypeCd 0001 is real estate. The window is the 개찰일 range the request names.

announcement_bid_result_list.$comment: 공고 입찰결과목록 (data.go.kr 15157222), the announcements whose opening fell in the window.

item_bid_result.$comment: 물건 입찰결과상세 (data.go.kr 15157254), one call per closed item condition, oldest first, within the daily limit; the rest wait for the next run. A 03 answer is recorded as asked (the provider has no result yet) and asked again after retry_after_hours, at most max_asks times.

status_codes.$comment: pbctStatCd, the provider's meanings (swagger). Values only; a consumer maps them to its own words.

pnu.$comment: ADR-0280 §3: the provider's ltnoPnu is the key as given. A value Pnu::parse would refuse (not 19 ASCII digits, or a 대장구분 digit outside this list) keeps pnu null and its raw text in ltno_pnu_raw. The Silver load reads these values; a test in lakehouse-domain asserts they are exactly what foundation_shared_kernel::Pnu::parse accepts.
